dialogue.origin: こんにちわ
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 聞こえますか？
dialogue.content: Can you hear me?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、今日は宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.origin: 良かったです。宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: I’m glad. I look forward to it as well, thank you.

dialogue.origin: どの様なご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 主人のことで。
dialogue.content: It's about my husband.

dialogue.origin: ハイ、ご主人様のことですね。
dialogue.content: I see—it’s about your husband.

dialogue.origin: どの様なことがお悩みですか
dialogue.content: What specifically is troubling you?

dialogue.origin: はい、主人がひどく怒るのです。
dialogue.content: Yes, my husband gets terribly angry.

dialogue.origin: それは、おつらいですね。
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: いつもいつも怒る感じですか？
dialogue.content: Does he seem angry all the time?

dialogue.origin: はい。毎日。直ぐに怒ります
dialogue.content: Yes. Every day. He gets angry right away.

dialogue.origin: 萎縮してしまって。
dialogue.content: It makes me feel so intimidated.

dialogue.origin: それでは気持ちがやすまらないですね。。。特に何にを言われますか？
dialogue.content: That must make it hard to feel at ease. What kinds of things does he say to you in particular?

dialogue.origin: お金を貯めろとか、使いすぎとか、食事が下手くそとか、色々
dialogue.content: Things like 'Save money,' 'You spend too much,' 'Your cooking is terrible,' and various other things.

dialogue.origin: 私が失敗するから
dialogue.content: It's because I make mistakes.

dialogue.origin: それは心が折れそうですよね。一生懸命されているのに、、、
dialogue.content: That sounds heartbreaking, especially when you're trying so hard.

dialogue.origin: 主人には一生懸命しているように写ってなくて
dialogue.content: He doesn't see it as me trying my best.

dialogue.origin: サボってるとか、もっと節約しろとか
dialogue.content: He says I'm slacking off, or that I need to be more frugal.

dialogue.origin: 家に居場所がないです
dialogue.content: I feel like I have no place in my own home.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それはつらいです。ご主人は、細かい性格ですか？
dialogue.content: I see. That's so hard. Is your husband a meticulous person?

dialogue.origin: はい、細かいです。きっちりはしていて、怒ると怖いんです
dialogue.content: Yes, he is meticulous. He’s very particular, and when he gets angry, it’s scary.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは委縮しちゃいますよね。お食事は毎日の事だし、気が滅入りますよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. That would make anyone feel intimidated. And since meals are an everyday thing, it must be really disheartening.

dialogue.origin: 他の人はそんな風には思わないみたいですが、
dialogue.content: Other people don’t seem to think of him that way, though.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 怖い時は家庭の中だけですか？
dialogue.content: Is he only scary at home?

dialogue.origin: もう、知らない出ていけ、呆れてると連発されるから
dialogue.content: He repeatedly tells me things like, "I don't care anymore, just get out," or "I'm fed up with you."

dialogue.origin: 一緒に出掛けてくれません
dialogue.content: He won't go out with me.

dialogue.origin: 昨日は実家に泊まりました
dialogue.content: I stayed at my parents’ house last night.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。連発はつらいですね。一緒に出掛けたいとおもうんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. Being told those things repeatedly must be tough. You want to go out together, don't you?

dialogue.origin: ご実家へ？
dialogue.content: You went to your parents' house?

dialogue.origin: はい、実家の母は世間体ばかりきにするから
dialogue.content: Yes, but my mother only cares about what other people think.

dialogue.origin: 離婚したいと言っても多分味方になってくれない
dialogue.content: Even if I say I want a divorce, she probably won't be on my side.

dialogue.origin: 2度目の結婚だから、尚更
dialogue.content: All the more so because it’s my second marriage.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ご両親は心配されてると思いますが、理解が無いのですね。意見が全く合わない感じ、、、つらいですね
dialogue.content: I understand. I'm sure your parents are worried, but it sounds like they aren't very understanding. It must be painful to feel like your opinions don't align at all.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちをわかって欲しいところですね。
dialogue.content: You just want them to understand how you feel, don't you?

dialogue.origin: 私にも問題はあると思うけど、
dialogue.content: I think I have my own issues, too, but...

dialogue.origin: 何かきづくことありますか
dialogue.content: Is there anything you’ve noticed about that?

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいのか解らなくて。私のやり方が主人は気に入らないから
dialogue.content: I don’t know what to do. My husband doesn’t like the way I do things.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。。。ご結婚されてどのくらいなんですか
dialogue.content: I see... How long have you been married?

dialogue.origin: 5年ほどです
dialogue.content: About five years.

dialogue.origin: 怒られて慣れてきてはいたけど、
dialogue.content: I was getting used to being yelled at, but...

dialogue.origin: 慣れてきた五年、、、ちょうど色々出てくるころなんでしょうんね。
dialogue.content: Five years of getting used to it... that's probably a time when various issues start to surface.

dialogue.origin: 以前は楽しいご主人さまでしたか
dialogue.content: Was your husband fun to be with before?

dialogue.origin: 1年目から泣いてました。出ていけと言われ、嫌われてしまったら、もう本当は離婚したいけど、母が
dialogue.content: I've been crying since the first year. He told me to get out, and since I know he hates me, I really want a divorce, but my mother...

dialogue.origin: 許してくれないから。我慢して5年。
dialogue.content: ...won't allow it. So I've endured it for five years.

dialogue.origin: すべて我慢の連続、、、親を思って踏み出せない、、、感じなのですね
dialogue.content: It's been nothing but endurance... You feel you can't take the step forward because of your parents, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本当によく我慢してこられましたね
dialogue.content: You've truly endured so much.

dialogue.origin: 全て自分が悪いと思ってしまうように
dialogue.content: It's gotten to the point where I feel like everything is my fault.

dialogue.origin: ご自分を責めないでくださいね。。。
dialogue.content: Please don’t blame yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: きっと、なにか解決策、ありますから、、、
dialogue.content: I’m sure there is a solution.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい、一緒に考えてみませんか？
dialogue.content: Yes, shall we think about it together?

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: まず、どのように接していくか、、、接しかたは色々ありますね
dialogue.content: First, there are various ways to approach how to interact with him.

dialogue.origin: ご主人もお疲れなところも、きっとあるんだと思います。
dialogue.content: I'm sure your husband has his own stresses and fatigue as well.

dialogue.origin: 私の接し方が下手くそなんだと思います。
dialogue.content: I think my way of interacting is clumsy.

dialogue.origin: 私の全てにイライラしています
dialogue.content: He gets irritated with everything about me.

dialogue.origin: 謝っても、
dialogue.content: Even if I apologize,

dialogue.origin: 謝らなくても
dialogue.content: and even if I don't,

dialogue.origin: 怒るから
dialogue.content: he gets angry.

dialogue.origin: 黙る。そしたら更に怒る
dialogue.content: So I stay silent. Then he gets even angrier.

dialogue.origin: 本当に、すべてにおいて、、、機嫌が悪いのですね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like he's truly in a bad mood about everything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: おつらいですね。。。
dialogue.content: That must be so hard for you.

dialogue.origin: 少しでも、気持ちが通じれば、、、
dialogue.content: If only your feelings could get through to him, even a little...

dialogue.origin: 仕事から帰ってきて、機嫌悪いから、そっとしていても
dialogue.content: When he comes home from work, he's in a bad mood, so even if I leave him alone...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: これが出来てない
dialogue.content: 'This isn't done.'

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 何していた！
dialogue.content: 'What have you been doing?!'

dialogue.origin: 完璧主義なんですね。
dialogue.content: He sounds like a perfectionist.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: He might be.

dialogue.origin: 私はいい加減な方だから
dialogue.content: Because I'm the careless type.

dialogue.origin: 神経がもたないですね、、、よく耐えてきましたね。
dialogue.content: That must be nerve-wracking... you've held up so well.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 我慢強いですね
dialogue.content: You are very patient.

dialogue.origin: いえ、昔、鬱とかあって
dialogue.content: No, I used to have depression...

dialogue.origin: 薬飲んでた時もあるから、また、戻ってしまわないかと、不安に。
dialogue.content: I was on medication for it at one point, so I'm worried I might relapse.

dialogue.origin: はい。心配ですね。心が病んでしまったのですね。我慢はいつか、体を壊しますから、、、
dialogue.content: Yes. That is a concern. Your spirit was worn down. Enduring too much will eventually take a toll on your body...

dialogue.origin: はい、主人は私の萎縮する所を直そうとしているのだと思うようにしていたけどら、
dialogue.content: Yes, I've been trying to think that my husband is just trying to correct my tendency to be timid, but...

dialogue.origin: はい、、、、これ以上、一緒にいるのは限界ですか？
dialogue.content: Yes... do you feel you've reached your limit for being with him?

dialogue.origin: はい、仕事終わって毎日、帰りたくなくて
dialogue.content: Yes, after work every day, I don't want to go home.

dialogue.origin: 憂鬱です。
dialogue.content: It's depressing.

dialogue.origin: 駆け込むことができるご実家も居場所はなさそうですか
dialogue.content: And it sounds like even your parents' house, where you could take refuge, isn't a safe place for you?

dialogue.origin: 勇気を出して昨日話したのですが、母は私がワガママを言ってると思ってるのと、やはり世間体を気にしてる
dialogue.content: I worked up the courage to talk to her yesterday, but my mother thinks I'm being selfish and, as I thought, she's worried about what people will think.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。どうしても厳しい状況でっすね、、、委縮してしまうと、考える事も出来なくなるので、
dialogue.content: I see. It's a really tough situation... When you feel so intimidated, it becomes hard to think clearly, so...

dialogue.origin: 少し、距離を置いても良いように感じますが、、、
dialogue.content: I feel like it might be good to put some distance between you...

dialogue.origin: 2度目だから、また世間に知れたら、とか言います。
dialogue.content: She says things like, "It's your second time, what if people find out again."

dialogue.origin: はい、友達の家も考えました
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ve considered staying at a friend’s house.

dialogue.origin: 職場に寝泊まりしようかなとか
dialogue.content: Or maybe even sleeping at my workplace.

dialogue.origin: そこまで？本当に限界ですよね、、、、
dialogue.content: To that extent? You've really reached your limit, haven't you...

dialogue.origin: はい。主人が私を嫌ってるのを知ったから
dialogue.content: Yes. Because I know now that my husband hates me.

dialogue.origin: 母を説得して別れるしかないかなと思いながら
dialogue.content: I’m thinking I may have no choice but to persuade my mother and separate.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、、悲しいですね。そうですね、まずはお母様のご理解が欲しいですね
dialogue.content: I see... that's so sad. Yes, first of all, you need your mother's understanding.

dialogue.origin: もっと私が強くならなきゃと思います
dialogue.content: I think I need to become stronger.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね！
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s right!

dialogue.origin: 強くなること、大事だと思います
dialogue.content: I think becoming stronger is important.

dialogue.origin: 泣いて目を腫らして仕事に行きたくないです
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to work with puffy eyes from crying.

dialogue.origin: 強くなって前に進みましょう！
dialogue.content: Let’s become stronger and move forward!

dialogue.origin: どうしたら強くなれますか？
dialogue.content: How can I become stronger?

dialogue.origin: はい、では、それを今から一緒に考えましょう！少しお話を整理指せてくださいね
dialogue.content: Okay, let's think about that together right now! Please allow me to summarize our conversation a bit.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 五年前に結婚されたご主人が、すべてにおいて否定的。ご実家のお母様も離婚に理解が無い。
dialogue.content: Your husband, whom you married five years ago, is negative about everything. And your mother is not understanding about a divorce.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、ご相談者さまは、お母様を説得して、離婚に踏み込みたい、、、という気持ちがある。
dialogue.content: But you feel you want to persuade your mother and move forward with a divorce.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 強くなろう！と努力もしている。
dialogue.content: You're also making an effort to become stronger.

dialogue.origin: 努力出来ているかどうかは解らないです
dialogue.content: I don't know if I'm succeeding in my efforts.

dialogue.origin: 本当は、お強いんだとおもいます。
dialogue.content: I think you are actually very strong.

dialogue.origin: 強くないですよ
dialogue.content: I’m not strong.

dialogue.origin: これまで我慢してこられて、、、
dialogue.content: You've endured all this time...

dialogue.origin: 口答え出来ずにスルーしてきただけのような
dialogue.content: It feels like I’ve just been letting things slide without being able to talk back.

dialogue.origin: そのスルー出来る事も本当は凄いですよ！でも、もう鬱にはなりたくないですよね？
dialogue.content: Being able to ignore it is actually amazing! But you don't want to fall into depression again, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: では、まずはお母様を、、、
dialogue.content: Then, first, regarding your mother...

dialogue.origin: しっかり気持ちを伝えられますか？
dialogue.content: Can you firmly convey your feelings to her?

dialogue.origin: 伝えたい事、、、真剣に話すと必ず通じていくものです。。。
dialogue.content: The things you want to say... if you speak earnestly, you'll always get through to them.

dialogue.origin: スルーは間違いじゃなかったのでしょうか？気持ちを母に伝えてみます
dialogue.content: Was letting things slide not a mistake? I’ll try to tell my mother how I feel.

dialogue.origin: 2度も離婚って自信喪失だけど、
dialogue.content: Getting divorced twice is a huge blow to my confidence, but...

dialogue.origin: やってみます
dialogue.content: I’ll try.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。はい、そうですね。前進していきましょう！
dialogue.content: It will be okay. Yes, that’s right. Let’s keep moving forward!

dialogue.origin: まだ何かお話したい事ありますか
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you would like to talk about?

dialogue.origin: スルーするのを怒られていたけど
dialogue.content: He would get angry at me for ignoring him, though.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 逃げてるとか
dialogue.content: Saying things like I'm running away,

dialogue.origin: 何か言え！とか
dialogue.content: or 'Say something!'

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 上手く喋れないから百倍になって返ってくるから
dialogue.content: I'm not good at speaking, so if I try, it comes back at me a hundred times worse.

dialogue.origin: 黙って、スルーするように、、、
dialogue.content: So I learned to be quiet and just ignore it...

dialogue.origin: 仕方ないですよね？
dialogue.content: I didn't have a choice, did I?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、、怖いかもしれませんが、きちんと向き合うことも大切です。ただ、まともに会話にならないので、、、
dialogue.content: That's true... it might be scary, but it's also important to face things properly. However, since you can't have a proper conversation...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そこは、スルーで大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.content: In that case, ignoring it is fine.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 応援してますね。毅然とした態度で。。。
dialogue.content: I’m rooting for you. Approach your mother with a firm, resolute attitude.

dialogue.origin: はい、頑張ります。今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ll do my best. Thank you for today.

dialogue.origin: 新しい自分をつくりましょう！！！
dialogue.content: Let’s create a new you!

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい、ではこれで相談を終了させていただきます。
dialogue.content: Alright, we will conclude the session here.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: You did well today.

topic.sub: 夫の怒りの感情とその影響
